description: Paragraph 0 was the stray fragment "lustige Person._" left over from the dropped cast-list heading "_Director, Theaterdichter, lustige Person._". Replaced with the restored, complete cast-list stage direction "[DIRECTOR, THEATERDICHTER, LUSTIGE PERSON]" (raw lines 111-112). This single fix satisfies both the Defect-3 fragment-removal and the Defect-2 missing-opening-stage-direction for this chapter.

Paragraph 0 was missing "Der Herr, die himmlischen Heerscharen," (raw line 367), the first line of the scene-opening cast list; only "nachher Mephistopheles." and the stage direction "Die drey Erzengel treten vor." had survived. Restored the missing opening line.

Last paragraph ended with the stray fragment "Der Tragödie", which is heading-bleed from the NEXT chapter's title "Der Tragödie erster Theil." (raw lines 547-549), not part of Mephistopheles' closing line in this scene. Removed the bleed; Mephistopheles' line now correctly ends at "...selbst zu sprechen."

Re-split the Easter-walk crowd scene (raw lines 1159-1336). Restored the opening stage direction "Spaziergänger aller Art ziehen hinaus." (new paragraph 0) and 18 dropped speaker labels (Einige Handwerksbursche, Die Ersten, Ein Handwerksbursch, Zweyter, Die Zweyten, Ein Dritter, Vierter, Fünfter->Dienstmädchen split, Andre->Erste split, Schüler->Bürgermädchen split, Zweyter Schüler (new bracket + label), Erster, Bürger, Bettler->Andrer Bürger->Dritter Bürger split, Alte->Bürgermädchen split, Die Andre->Soldaten split), turning 12 merged/mislabeled paragraphs into 30 correctly attributed paragraphs. Verified programmatically that concatenating the dialogue text of the new paragraphs (stripped of labels/brackets) exactly reproduces the old merged dialogue text.

Split the paragraph mislabeled entirely as ALTER BAUER at old index 37: the closing couplet "Gesundheit dem bewährten Mann, Daß er noch lange helfen kann!" is spoken by the crowd as a whole (raw line 1468, "_Alle._"), not by Alter Bauer. Restored the ALLE. speaker label for the second part.
